description: This file defines inline functions for integrity protection algorithms (NIA1, NIA2, NIA3) and a verification function for short MACs, implementing security features per 3GPP specifications within the ocudu::security namespace.

methods.name: security_nia1
methods.description: Implements the NIA1 integrity algorithm, copying the message buffer to a contiguous memory and calling s3g_f9 with appropriate parameters.

methods.name: security_nia2_cmac
methods.description: Performs CMAC-based integrity calculation using mbedtls cipher functions, generating a MAC over the message segments.

methods.name: security_nia2_non_cmac
methods.description: Implements NIA2 integrity algorithm without CMAC, using AES ECB mode and CMAC-like processing with subkey generation.

methods.name: security_nia2
methods.description: Selects between CMAC and non-CMAC implementation of NIA2 based on compile-time macro.

methods.name: security_nia3
methods.description: Implements the NIA3 integrity algorithm, generating a MAC using ZUC stream cipher and message-specific IV.

methods.name: verify_short_mac
methods.description: Verifies a received short MAC against an expected value computed with specified integrity algorithms and configuration.
